_why: RAY OF SICKNESS UPCAST smoke test (2026-11-08): a level-3 wizard with both pools full casts Ray of Sickness at 2nd level against the Zombie (poison-immune, same target used for the original Ray of Sickness tests) -- confirms 3d8 is rolled (not 2d8), only the 2nd-level pool drops, and the Poisoned condition still lands despite the damage itself reading 0 from immunity.

stats.wizard_spell_4_desc: Ray of Sickness—a sickly green ray of raw poison that leaves whatever it strikes nauseated and reeling long after the light fades.
